mapper.insert: insert into submission(user_id, problem_id, language, code, status, time_used, memory_used, error_message, fail_case, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{problemId}, #{language}, #{code}, #{status}, #{timeUsed}, #{memoryUsed}, #{errorMessage}, #{failCase}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update:
UPDATE submission
status = #{status},
time_used = #{timeUsed},
memory_used = #{memoryUsed},
error_message = #{errorMessage},
fail_case = #{failCase},
language = #{language},
code = #{code},
update_time = NOW()
WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: select count(*) from submission where user_id = #{userId} and problem_id = #{problemId}
select count(*) from submission where problem_id = #{problemId}
